verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's documented change history keeps a running log of changes to feature flags in each environment. It also supports rolling a flag back to a previous version, which implies prior values are retained. The evidence does not explicitly show that each entry records who made the change or when. missing for 10: explicit documentation of actor (who) and timestamp (when) per entry, explicit before/after value diffs, audit log export/API access, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every flag change is recorded in an audit log — who changed what, when, and to which value

citations.quote: LaunchDarkly keeps a running log of changes made to feature flags and other resources in each environment.
You can also use the change history to [roll back](/docs/home/releases/version-restore) a flag to a previous version.
